paper.title: KnowU-Bench: Towards Interactive, Proactive, and Personalized Mobile Agent Evaluation

evidence.section: Abstract; benchmark environment and evaluation protocol
evidence.figure_or_table: Benchmark overview and main evaluation tables
evidence.paraphrase: A reproducible Android environment hides user profiles and exposes behavioral logs, requiring agents to infer preferences, ask clarifying questions, calibrate proactive intervention, and execute personalized GUI tasks.

adjudication_notes: Retained as memory-adjacent because the benchmark targets personalization and proactive interaction broadly, although behavioral-history reuse is necessary.
